summary: Third package, a correction to a conclusion this contributor had itself recorded. After the depth-5 seven-stratum arm was stopped by the repository owner at 32 of 64 planned games, re-derived every figure independently and confirmed the coordinator's: mean 411,874, moves 117.97, work/move 176,536,117, 3,775 decisions, 0 incomplete, 0 censored, 0 identity failures; d5s7-d4s7 +23,367 [-83,046] 17-0-15 median +18,820 (against -1,581 median -39,660 at n=16, a SIGN FLIP, chunk means -1,581 and +48,315); d5s7-d5s5 +123,613 [+32,575] SIGNIFICANT 19-0-13; d5s7-d3s7 +86,397 [-6,303] 20-0-12; d5s5-d4s5 unchanged at -8,624 [-55,134]. Independently reproduced the whole detection-floor table (1.645*sd/sqrt(n)) to the digit - 268,413/55,192, 298,877/61,457, 228,827/47,052, 371,351/107,988 - and extended it with the two contrasts the coordinator's table omitted, d5s7-d5s5 (floor 95,207, above) and d5s7-d3s7 (floor 97,211, below), confirming that every significant result in the factorial is above its floor and every null below it. Confirmed 683.4 games needed to resolve +23,367, SE 46,419 had the arm finished at 64, and the five largest single-seed paired deltas. Answered the bootstrap-versus-normal question: the two agree on the significance call for all six contrasts, with the percentile bootstrap systematically 0.5k-4.5k less conservative (1-5% of half-width), and reported paired-delta skewness (+0.55 to +0.92 on four contrasts, -0.30 on d5s7-d4s7) so the closeness is not mistaken for equivalence. Wrote result RS-20260821T205102Z-d89df4b5 superseding RS-20260821T181917Z-9a34ba02 under the same forward-only convention, carrying the headline correction that the earlier 'does not separate' reading was a non-measurement reported as a null and that +23,367 is equally unsupported; set scientificOutcome to inconclusive and assessment to mixed rather than fail/not-supported, and updated the theory record's assessment to mixed. Registered run RUN-20260821T060358Z-93cb9bfc for the stopped execution with a frozen 32-game snapshot and content manifest, recording the stop as a deliberate resource decision with its computed rationale. Appended section 10 to finding-15 and rebuilt its top banner as a three-row table making the sequence of two withdrawn readings legible.
validationPerformed: make research-validate: schema, ID, cross-reference, per-game artifact hash, machine-profile, seed-lease and markdown-link checks, plus the research unit tests

Re-ran approaches/lifetime-objective/fast-engine/finish.sh on the stopped cohort; output retained verbatim at runs/RUN-20260821T060358Z-93cb9bfc/finish-report-final.txt, and every paired figure in the record is taken from it

Recomputed all six paired contrasts, their paired standard deviations, standard errors, detection floors and sample skewness outside the repository tooling, reproducing the coordinator's four-row power table exactly and extending it by two rows
Reimplemented the Mulberry32 percentile bootstrap independently and compared it to the normal approximation on all six contrasts: identical significance calls, bootstrap 0.5k-4.5k less conservative

Verified the stop was clean from the artifact and log: gamesComplete 32, 32 seed lines in the log, 0 censored, 0 identity failures, 0 incomplete decisions, minCompletedDepth 5, busiest decision at 80% of its declared bound; process 127323 confirmed gone
Verified all 36 entries across the four content manifests still hash correctly, and that the two superseded records and the four earlier committed records are byte-unchanged
limitations: Analysis and record-writing only. The gameplay, the fast engine, the chunked runner and the decision to stop the arm are not this contributor's work.

This package corrects a conclusion this same contributor recorded twelve hours earlier at n=16. The error was reporting an underpowered point estimate as a null; the detection floor was not computed before the record was written.

One figure disagrees with the brief: the cost to resolve the contrast is about 13 wall-days at the run's own observed throughput (1,647 s per game at 14 threads), not 26. The two chunks differed 2.3x in throughput under other agents' load, so the honest range is 8-18 wall-days. The 684-game requirement itself reproduces exactly.

The superseded record RS-20260821T181917Z-9a34ba02 still carries assessment 'not-supported-as-tested' rather than 'superseded'; changing it would mean editing a committed result in place, which this repository has only ever done at record-creation time. Coordinator decision.
The detection floors are a normal approximation applied to skewed heavy-tailed paired deltas; they are planning quantities, not exact power guarantees.
gitCommit is null on the new run record because the arm ran from an uncommitted working tree; a source-closure hash is recorded instead.
